raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Fixes #33169

## Purpose
Add an environment-variable based configuration option for selecting the NIXL disaggregation transport backend.

Previously, switching between NIXL backends (e.g., UCX vs LIBFABRIC) required changing `kv_transfer_config.kv_connector_extra_config`. This PR introduces:
- `VLLM_NIXL_DISAGGREGATION_BACKEND`

### Behavior / Priority
- If `VLLM_NIXL_DISAGGREGATION_BACKEND` is set, it overrides `kv_transfer_config.kv_connector_extra_config["backends"]`.
- If unset, behavior is unchanged (falls back to config / default `["UCX"]`).

## Test Plan
- Lint / format:
  - `ruff format vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/nixl_connector.py`
  - `ruff check vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/nixl_connector.py`
- Syntax check:
  - `python -m compileall vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/nixl_connector.py`
- Unit test:
  - `pytest -q tests/distributed/kv_transfer/test_nixl_backend_env.py`

## Test Result
- `ruff check` / `ruff format`: PASS
- `python -m compileall`: PASS
- Unit test: Added `tests/distributed/kv_transfer/test_nixl_backend_env.py` (validated by CI; local pytest execution may abort due to environment-specific issues)
